version_contract: v1.0 release candidate with GNAT/GPRbuild library/test verification

public_packages.name: I18N
public_packages.role: Stable root namespace for ICU Messages Ada public packages

public_packages.name: I18N.Runtime
public_packages.role: Catalog-backed runtime initialization and public rendering facade

primary_subprograms.name: Initialize
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Initialize (Runtime : in out I18N.Runtime.Instance; Catalog_Path : String)
primary_subprograms.behavior: Reads and validates a line-oriented catalog into normalized runtime entries. Invalid catalogs put the runtime into a deterministic invalid state.

primary_subprograms.name: Render
primary_subprograms.signature_summary: Render (Item : Instance; Locale : I18N.Locales.Locale_Id; Key : String; Arguments : I18N.Arguments.Arguments) return I18N.Result.Render_Result
primary_subprograms.behavior: Renders a catalog key using deterministic locale fallback and returns structured status/text.

public_packages.name: I18N.Result
public_packages.role: Stable public result and status model
contract_notes: Render_Result is a bounded, non-discriminated public result value; use Output_Text(Result.Text) to read the meaningful rendered string.

public_packages.name: I18N.Arguments
contract_notes: Arguments is a limited, mutable, noncopyable public argument map; callers update it with Set/Clear, use Copy for explicit duplication, and pass it by reference to Render.

public_packages.name: I18N.Locales
public_packages.role: Locale identifier type and fallback behavior

public_packages.name: I18N.Diagnostics
public_packages.role: Optional diagnostics facade with non-interference guarantee

primary_subprograms.name: Set_Trace_Callback
primary_subprograms.behavior: Installs or clears optional observational tracing; callback exceptions are contained.

catalog_format.value_separator: Only the first = separates key from value; later = characters are part of the message value
catalog_format.binary_catalogs: not shipped in v1.0; future binary catalogs must be versioned and rejected deterministically when unsupported
catalog_format.empty_message_value: valid; an explicitly present empty message renders as Success with empty text

allowed_after_v1: add new ICU features without changing existing behavior

api_visibility_enforcement: Ada private child packages for internal/regression units; ordinary downstream application units cannot with them.
test_namespace: I18N.Runtime.Tests.* regression units are descendants of I18N.Runtime so they can legally import I18N.Runtime.Compatibility, which is a private child of I18N.Runtime.
production_path: text catalog -> deterministic catalog validation -> locale/key lookup -> public catalog render -> structured public result

release_verification_required.verified_status: core library build, test project build, and AUnit runner passed for this handoff
release_verification_required.storage_warning_status: I18N.Errors.Result no longer uses discriminated string storage that triggered the GNAT Storage_Error warning
release_verification_required.private_package_sealing: accepted by GNAT for the library/test build; examples remain a publication smoke check

package_metadata.publication_status: source crate metadata present; GNAT/GPRbuild release verification still required before publication
